title: DAL Study 1 - Research redesign, pilot diagnosis, and preregistered protocol
outcome: Produce a canonical pilot forensic diagnosis, a current literature refresh with a novelty-gap statement, a benchmark/licensing/contamination dossier, a zero-cost compute plan, and a preregistered Study 1 protocol with a sealed untouched final-evaluation split, before any Study 1 training or evaluation.
rationale: The founder authorized a scientific restart on 2026-10-02. Study 0 showed a null, majority-class-like action result and a constructed abstention benchmark. A definitive study must first diagnose the pilot, re-establish the literature gap, choose benchmarks it has never inspected, and preregister hypotheses and endpoints so that later development cannot drift toward a convenient result.
scope_in: Non-destructive D1 forensic diagnosis of immutable Study 0 raw predictions

Literature refresh across medical QA, reasoning, abstention, selective prediction, calibration, uncertainty, metacognition, evidence-grounded QA, medical RAG, claim verification, clinical agents, and FHIR agents, with citation chasing and original-source verification
Novelty-gap statement derived from the refresh
Benchmark dossier with versions, hashes, licenses, inclusion/exclusion rules, Study 0 exposure, and contamination risk
Zero-cost compute plan with explicit founder-account boundaries

Preregistered Study 1 protocol with research questions, hypotheses, primary/secondary/exploratory endpoints, baselines, ablations, metrics, statistics, development stages D2-D7, D8 freeze rules, and a sealed final split
Exact-head cross-platform CI plus Alibaba OpenCodeReview and secure TypeSafe Jev qualification
scope_out: No Study 1 model training, tuning, or evaluation
No inspection of sealed final-split labels
No change to Study 0 evidence, claims, or frozen digests
No reuse of any Study 0 PubMedQA PQA-L row as a blind final evaluation
No novelty claim unsupported by the refresh
No founder-paid tools, APIs, compute, datasets, or reviewers
acceptance: Canonical dependency is Study 0 closeout main 4e6ed79aebffce10d812bf6871888eb028b8af09
Pilot diagnosis is generated deterministically from immutable Study 0 raw predictions and changes no Study 0 artifact
Literature refresh records sources, queries, dates, screening, citation chasing, tool substitutions, and verified identifiers
Benchmark dossier records license and Study 0 exposure for every candidate
Protocol freezes a primary endpoint and seals the final split by deterministic hashing before any label inspection
Exact-head GAXBench, Alibaba OpenCodeReview, and secure Jev pass on every head; normal merges with expected-head guards; post-main verification after every merge

risk.recovery: If any redesign step would require inspecting sealed final labels, reusing Study 0 test rows as blind evidence, or paid resources, stop and record the blocker instead.

development_stages: D10 paper evidence and publication package
